license_required.quote: It shall be unlawful for any person to profess to be a podiatrist, to practice or assume the duties incidental to podiatry...without first obtaining from the board a license authorizing the practice of podiatry in this state

issuing_authority.quote: "Board" means the state board of healing arts.

age_minimum.quote: Shall have attained the age of 21 years

degree_required.quote: shall have completed at least four years of instruction in, and be graduates of, a school of podiatry which is recognized as being in good standing by the board

accrediting_body.quote: a school of podiatry which is recognized as being in good standing by the board

required.quote: commencing with applicants for a license to be granted on or after July 1, 1988, shall have completed acceptable postgraduate study as may be established by the board by rules and regulations

kind.quote: shall have completed acceptable postgraduate study as may be established by the board by rules and regulations

exams.name: Board examination in podiatry subjects
exams.notes: Subjects include anatomy, bacteriology, chemistry, dermatology, histology, pathology, physiology, pharmacology and medicine, diagnosis, therapeutics, and clinical podiatry and surgery
exams.quote: each applicant for a license to practice podiatry shall be examined by the board in the following subjects: Anatomy, bacteriology, chemistry, dermatology, histology, pathology, physiology, pharmacology and medicine, diagnosis, therapeutics, and clinical podiatry and surgery

required.quote: Every licensed podiatrist in the active practice of podiatry within Kansas shall submit with the request for renewal...evidence of satisfactory completion of a continuing education course approved by the board.

available.quote: Applicants licensed, registered or certified by a board of examiners of any other state or country whose requirements for licensure, registration or certification are substantially equal to those of this state...may be granted...a license without examination.

requirements.value: Requirements of other state or country must be substantially equal to Kansas requirements in the opinion of the state board of healing arts; payment of endorsement license fee required.
requirements.quote: Applicants licensed, registered or certified by a board of examiners of any other state or country whose requirements for licensure, registration or certification are substantially equal to those of this state in the opinion of the state board of healing arts may be granted, upon payment of the endorsement license fee established pursuant to K.S.A. 65-2012, and amendments thereto, a license without examination.

definition_quote.value: Podiatry means the diagnosis and medical and surgical treatment of all illnesses of the human foot, including the ankle and tendons which insert into the foot as well as the foot, subject to subsection (d) of K.S.A. 65-2002.
definition_quote.quote: "Podiatry" means the diagnosis and medical and surgical treatment of all illnesses of the human foot, including the ankle and tendons which insert into the foot as well as the foot, subject to subsection (d) of K.S.A. 65-2002

methods_authorized.quote: A licensed podiatrist shall be authorized to prescribe such drugs or medicine, and to perform such surgery on the human foot, ankle and tendons that insert into the foot

drug_authority.value: A licensed podiatrist shall be authorized to prescribe such drugs or medicine as may be necessary to the proper practice of podiatry.
drug_authority.quote: A licensed podiatrist shall be authorized to prescribe such drugs or medicine, and to perform such surgery on the human foot, ankle and tendons that insert into the foot, including amputation of the toes or part of the foot, as may be necessary to the proper practice of podiatry

anatomical_scope_upper_boundary.quote: the diagnosis and medical and surgical treatment of all illnesses of the human foot, including the ankle and tendons which insert into the foot as well as the foot

amputation_authorized.quote: including amputation of the toes or part of the foot, as may be necessary to the proper practice of podiatry, but no podiatrist shall amputate the human foot

anesthesia_authority.quote: no podiatrist shall...administer any anesthetic other than local

ankle_surgery_authorized.quote: No podiatrist shall perform surgery on the ankle unless such person has completed a two-year post-doctoral surgical residency program prior to July 1, 2007, or a three-year post-doctoral surgical residency program on or after July 1, 2007

ankle_surgery_residency_requirement.quote: completed a two-year post-doctoral surgical residency program prior to July 1, 2007, or a three-year post-doctoral surgical residency program on or after July 1, 2007, in reconstructive rearfoot/ankle surgery

ankle_surgery_facility_requirement.quote: Surgical treatment of the ankle by a podiatrist shall be performed only in a medical care facility, as defined in K.S.A. 65-425, and amendments thereto.

value: nationally recognized certifying organization acceptable to the board
board_certification_body.quote: is either board-certified or board qualified progressing to board certification in reconstructive rearfoot/ankle surgery by a nationally recognized certifying organization acceptable to the board

professional_liability_insurance_require.quote: the board, prior to renewal of a license, shall require the licensee, if in the active practice of podiatry within Kansas, to submit to the board evidence satisfactory to the board that the licensee is maintaining a policy of professional liability insurance as required by K.S.A. 40-3402

corrective_footwear_exemption.quote: This act shall not prohibit the recommendation, advertising, fitting or sale of corrective shoes, arch supports, or similar mechanical appliances, or foot remedies by manufacturers, wholesalers or retail dealers.
